controles.affirmation: L'affaire Varian Medical Systems, Inc. v. Commissioner est 'un precedent externe sur les prix de transfert'
controles.verbatim_source: In 2024, we recorded a $14.4 million tax benefit for additional foreign tax credits that became available as a result of a U.S. Tax Court ruling in Varian Medical Systems, Inc. v. Commissioner, issued on August 26, 2024. The ruling addressed the U.S. tax treatment of deemed foreign dividends recognized during the transition year of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (our fiscal 2018). On April 8, 2026, the U.S. Tax Court granted summary judgment in favor of the IRS, and as a result, we reversed the previously recognized tax benefit. (10-Q T3 FY2026, Note 9)
controles.correction_proposee: Il ne s'agit pas de prix de transfert mais du traitement fiscal americain des dividendes etrangers reputes recus lors de l'annee de transition du Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, et de credits d'impot etrangers. Les 14,4 M$ sont la REPRISE d'un avantage fiscal comptabilise en 2024, apres le jugement sommaire du 8 avril 2026 en faveur de l'IRS. Reformuler : 'un litige fiscal externe portant sur les credits d'impot etrangers, dont l'issue defavorable a oblige PTC a reprendre un avantage fiscal de 14,4 M$'.
